name: Village of Mamaroneck
gaps: § 342-27.1 FAR is interpolated between rows; bands interpolate the gross-floor-area column, a close linear approximation
R-4F/P and RM-1/P are county codes not named in the code; mapped to R-4F and RM-1
RM districts allow one-family houses but the schedule has only multifamily rows; those values are recorded
RM/SC stories printed as '8 (4 1/2 on wide streets)' in the schedule; recorded 8
P Parking district allows no dwellings; yards set by the Planning Board (3-20 ft), so front/side/rear are null
No steep slope law and no accessory apartment/ADU provision found in the Village code
No minimum lot frontage separate from width (schedule column is 'lot width and frontage')

wetlands.summary: Ch. 192: wetlands (tidal wetlands and other wetland areas of 2,500 sf or more) plus a 100 ft adjacent area are a controlled area; regulated activities there need a Planning Board wetlands permit.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep slope protection law found in the Village code.

trees.summary: Ch. 318 (2021): permit to remove a protected tree, i.e. 8 in.+ DBH anywhere or 3 in.+ DBH in a wetland or wetland adjacent area.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 342 Art. XIV: SWPPP with erosion controls for 200-999 sf of land disturbance; full SWPPP with post-construction practices for 1,000 sf or more.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment provision found; one-family districts allow up to two roomers or boarders (§ 342-21B(6)).

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings/structures keep the district front and side setbacks and 6 ft from the rear line (Schedule Note 11). Detached garages max 20 ft high, max 1,200 sf and 25% of the house's floor area, 50 ft from the front line unless attached.
general.pools: Ch. 300: no pools in the front yard; pool and equipment at least 6 ft from the rear line, district side yards apply, 10 ft from any street line on corner lots; max 40% of the rear yard; 4 ft screening and fence.
general.notes: Height for one- and two-family houses measured from pre-construction grade to the mean of eaves and ridge for pitched roofs. Rooms over 12 ft high count 1.5x in gross floor area.

R-20.name: R-20 One-Family

max_impervious_coverage.note: Maximum building coverage and impervious surfaces combined

max_floor_area.note: § 342-27.1 Residential FAR Schedule (0.53 at 5,000 sf down to 0.27 at 20,000+ sf). The code interpolates the FAR between 1,000 sf rows and multiplies by the lot; bands interpolate the schedule's gross floor area column instead (within ~15 sf). Rooms over 12 ft high count 1.5x; attics under 7 ft and mostly below-grade basements excluded.

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings/structures meet the district front and side setbacks and stay 6 ft from the rear line (Schedule Note 11). Detached garages: max 20 ft high, max 25% of the house's gross floor area and 1,200 sf (§ 342-21B(5)), 50 ft from the front line and 20 ft from a side street unless attached (§ 342-13B).

R-20.source: § 342-27 Schedule of Minimum Requirements for Residential Districts (Attachment 2), Note 11; § 342-27.1
R-20.notes: Corner lots: owner files a choice of two fronts, or one front with a street side yard increased to within 10 ft of the block's average front setback (§ 342-15.1). Front yard may need to match a pronounced existing alignment within 150 ft, max 50 ft (§ 342-15).
